"""Cipher Trail 的可复现题面与解码材料。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac

PAYLOAD = [214, 7, 9, 4, 14, 18, 52, 14, 7, 4, 22, 2, 52, 26, 31, 30, 7, 16, 39, 5, 26, 27, 27, 30, 50, 6, 6]
MASK = b"Violet"
EXPECTED_SHA256 = "35994aa7266e7749759f09ef4e12ffffa725dd2d797967293a20110a3436701e"


def decode() -> str:
    mixed = bytes(value ^ MASK[index % len(MASK)] for index, value in enumerate(PAYLOAD))
    return bytes((value - 3) & 0xFF for value in reversed(mixed)).decode()


def verify(candidate: str) -> bool:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(candidate.encode()).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(digest, EXPECTED_SHA256)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    candidate = decode()
    print("decoded candidate:", candidate)
    print("verified:", verify(candidate))

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac

PAYLOAD = [214, 7, 9, 4, 14, 18, 52, 14, 7, 4, 22, 2, 52, 26, 31, 30, 7, 16, 39, 5, 26, 27, 27, 30, 50, 6, 6]
MASK = b"Violet"
EXPECTED_SHA256 = "35994aa7266e7749759f09ef4e12ffffa725dd2d797967293a20110a3436701e"


def decode() -> str:

    return bytes((value - 3) & 0xFF for value in reversed(mixed)).decode()

    return hmac.compare_digest(digest, EXPECTED_SHA256)

    print("decoded candidate:", candidate)
